nativeAxes.origin: Native+Z entrance faces southwest at heading-1.2rad, toward the former keeper house/restaurant and road approach visible in the owner aerial. sourceFacts.basis: Royal Netherlands Navy2026 HP2B light4000/J6330 lists30m stone structure and55m focal elevation. Owner Monuments Fund Aruba publishes restoration history and opposed daylight/night/aerial facade photographs. Those photographs govern the14 staggered stair windows, octagonal pedestal, light-pink plaster, gallery stack and green cap; small dimensions are photograph-proportioned.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Static restored2016 exterior from owner daylight, sunset and aerial photographs. Published30m structural height excludes the thin vane;55m focal elevation does not mean55m tower height. Base5.3m diameter, pedestal/cup/gallery profiles, pediments and minor fittings are photo-proportioned. Night light sectors, interior staircase, current visitor status, detached restaurant/landscape, exact weathering and vane animation are outside this medium-fi architectural scope.

appearance.identity: Restored pale-rose taper over an octagonal cream-trimmed pedestal, fourteen staggered pedimented windows and four upper vents, projecting gallery cup, narrow service drum, two metal gallery decks, green domed lantern, vane and southwest entrance steps.
appearance.master: Exact preserved original restored California Lighthouse.
